activity.notes: Jair Bolsonaro served as President of the Federative Republic of Brazil from 1 January 2019 through 31 December 2022. He is a former, not current, officeholder, so the ATLAS current-officeholder exclusion does not apply.

sources.title: Jair Bolsonaro
sources.citation_text: Brazil’s Presidential Library lists Jair Bolsonaro’s government period as 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2022.
